title: Watch acknowledgements stay with their claimed batch
scope: The watch-task contract, acknowledgement bridge, durable batch state, and focused unit verification needed to review per-batch status posts and legacy unfinished-state migration; driver intake and final-outcome processing are excluded. The independent browser reply-draft area is handled by a separate map; PR-wide documentation and the compact CI-history change are left to direct code rather than joined by a same-PR relation.

presentation.thesis: Each acknowledgement is recorded on the operation for its claimed batch, while migration carries an unfinished legacy status post only to the applicable batch.

nodes.label: watch-state.mjs
nodes.description: Owns batch-scoped acknowledgement operations and migrates unfinished legacy status posts into them.

nodes.label: auto-ack.mjs
nodes.description: Claims a batch, creates or restores each operation acknowledgement, and records its returned post ID.
